name: Contract Renewal Alerts
query: SELECT em.custom_employee_id AS "Employee ID:Link/Employee:150", em.employee_name AS "Employee Name:150", -- Contract Details em.custom_contract_end_date_ec AS "Last Contract Renewal (E.C):150", em.contract_end_date AS "Last Contract Renewal (G.C):150", CURDATE() AS "Today:100", -- Days Remaining since last renewal DATEDIFF(em.contract_end_date, CURDATE()) AS "Days Remaining Since Renewal", -- 🎨 Visual status badge (does not alter existing logic/fields) CASE WHEN em.contract_end_date IS NULL THEN '⚪ No Date' WHEN DATEDIFF(em.contract_end_date, CURDATE()) < 0 THEN '🔴 Expired' WHEN DATEDIFF(em.contract_end_date, CURDATE()) <= 15 THEN '🟠 Urgent' WHEN DATEDIFF(em.contract_end_date, CURDATE()) <= 30 THEN '🟡 Soon' ELSE '🟢 Active' END AS "Status:HTML:130" FROM `tabEmployee` em WHERE em.status = 'Active' AND em.employment_type = 'ኮንትራት' ORDER BY (em.contract_end_date IS NULL) ASC, -- put NULLs at the end DATEDIFF(em.contract_end_date, CURDATE()) ASC;
